name: 崇福寺第一峰门
checkpoints: ONE central gateway under a broad single hip-and-gable roof, elaborate compact Chinese multilevel bracket stack above the opening.
Paired red doors stand open outward, preserve the dense three-leaf bracket pattern and fan-shaped rafters.
Remove flanking modern enclosures and plants; include short stone stairs; keep plaque shapes but NO text.
